data.narrative:
CX2 Industries is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Nathan Mintz and Porter Smith that has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage peers, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private comps include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $31M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $62M. The peer-median method examines the 10-company comparable set, which ranges from $125M to $3.0B, with a median valuation of $1.0B across Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns at Series B stage.

The triangulated range is $53M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $531M. This wide spread reflects material stage and maturity dispersion within the peer set—most comparable companies have advanced to Series B. The low end anchors to stage-progression methodology, while the high end reflects peer-median results. Key uncertainties include CX2's specific technical differentiation relative to the peer universe, revenue traction, and customer concentration in what remains a nascent, high-uncertainty sector. Further diligence on unit economics and go-to-market execution is warranted to narrow the range.
